component.name: WallStitch
component.summary: Stretch one wallpaper seamlessly across all your monitors

description.p: Linux desktops can't stretch a single wallpaper across several monitors. WallStitch reads your monitor layout, lets you position the image visually, then cuts it into one perfectly aligned piece per screen and sets them for you.

ul.li: Works with any layout: dual or triple monitors, ultrawides, stacked or offset screens, mixed resolutions and HiDPI scaling
Drag and zoom the image over a live preview of your monitors
Bezel compensation keeps straight lines straight across monitor frames
Browse random wallpapers from wallhaven.cc that fit your desktop's shape and resolution
Spanning slideshow of up to 50 images that changes every screen in sync, with per-image framing
One click restores your previous wallpaper
Command-line interface for scripts and dotfiles

description.p: KDE Plasma 6 is supported today; more desktops are planned.

screenshot.caption: Position one image across two monitors, with bezel compensation
Import wallpapers and run a slideshow that spans every screen

ul.li: Span one wallpaper across any monitor layout on KDE Plasma 6
Visual editor with pan, zoom and bezel compensation
Random wallpapers from wallhaven.cc sized for your desktop
Synced spanning slideshow of up to 50 images, with per-image framing
Restore your previous wallpaper; full command-line interface
